# Quora Scraper | No Cookies | $5 / 1K

## Overview

**Quora Scraper | No Cookies | $5 / 1K** collects public data from Quora, including questions, answers, posts, profiles, topics, and spaces. Quora hosts millions of discussions that reveal real user opinions, expertise, and interests, making it a rich source for research, outreach, LLM-ready Q&A corpora, and trend monitoring. This actor automates the process end-to-end so you can capture structured information reliably without manual browsing or handling cookies.

## Why Use This Actor

- **Research-ready insights:** Track conversations, sentiment, and recurring themes for market, product, content, and LLM research.
- **Lead and expert discovery:** Surface profiles and spaces where your audience or subject-matter experts are active.
- **Content inspiration:** Mine questions and answers to fuel blog posts, FAQs, and knowledge bases.
- **Directory building:** Compile lists of spaces, topics, or profiles with their key details for analysis or enrichment.
- **LLM training and evaluation:** Gather natural Q&A pairs, topic clusters, and long-form community discussions that can support dataset creation, benchmarking, and hallucination-spotting workflows.
- **Time and consistency:** Schedule repeat runs, keep datasets fresh, and export in formats that plug directly into your workflows.

## Input Parameters

| Parameter          | Type             | Description                                                                                                                                             | Default                                    |
| ------------------ | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `queries`          | array of strings | Search keywords to look up on Quora. Combine with `searchType` and `timeFilter` to refine results. Use this for scraping from search pages.             | `["Cheesecake", "acai bowl", "Elon Musk"]` |
| `searchType`       | string           | Content type returned for keyword searches. Options: `All types`, `Question`, `Answer`, `Post`, `Profile`, `Space`, `Topic`. Ignored for direct URLs.   | `Question`                                 |
| `timeFilter`       | string           | Limit keyword search results by recency. Options: `All Time`, `Past Hour`, `Past Day`, `Past Week`, `Past Month`, `Past Year`. Ignored for direct URLs. | `All Time`                                 |
| `startUrls`        | array of strings | Direct Quora URLs (search pages, profiles, spaces, topics, questions, answers, or posts). Use this to target specific pages without relying on search.  | Prefilled examples provided                |
| `maxItemsPerQuery` | integer          | Maximum number of results saved per keyword or direct URL (minimum 10).                                                                                 | `10000`                                    |

Connection routing is automatic: the actor starts with a direct connection and can use an internal proxy fallback if direct access is blocked.

## Example Input

Below are two ways to configure the actor:

### Scraping by Query 🎯 (use search keywords)

Use this when you want Quora search results filtered by content type and time window.

```json
{
    "queries": ["Human"],
    "searchType": "Space",
    "timeFilter": "Past Year",
    "maxItemsPerQuery": 50
}
```

**When to use:** Ideal for discovering spaces related to a topic (e.g., searching "Human" with `Space` returns matching spaces with their info and links).

### Scrape by Direct URL 🎯 (paste full Quora links)

Use this when you already have the exact pages to capture.

```json
{
    "startUrls": [
        "https://humanity.quora.com/",
        "https://www.quora.com/Is-AI-an-existential-threat-to-humanity",
        "https://www.quora.com/topic/Humans"
    ],
    "maxItemsPerQuery": 100
}
```

**When to use:** Perfect for scraping specific spaces, questions, or topics directly (e.g., providing `https://humanity.quora.com/` collects its posts and related details).

## Example Output

Each dataset item represents one captured result, with crawl metadata grouped under `source_context` and source-specific details grouped by content type.

```json
{
    "record_type": "answer",
    "url": "https://www.quora.com/Is-AI-an-existential-threat-to-humanity/answer/Example-Author",
    "source_context": {
        "seed_type": "keyword",
        "seed_value": "Human",
        "source_url": "https://www.quora.com/search?q=Human&type=answer",
        "loaded_url": "https://www.quora.com/search?q=Human&type=answer",
        "scraped_at": "2024-05-01T12:00:00.000Z",
        "search_type": "Answer",
        "search_time_filter": "Past Year"
    },
    "status": {
        "has_results": true
    },
    "question": {
        "id": 123456789,
        "title": "Is AI an existential threat to humanity?",
        "url": "https://www.quora.com/Is-AI-an-existential-threat-to-humanity",
        "posted_at": "2024-03-18T10:22:00.000Z",
        "metrics": {
            "answers": 120,
            "followers": 240,
            "comments": 8
        }
    },
    "answer": {
        "id": 987654321,
        "url": "https://www.quora.com/Is-AI-an-existential-threat-to-humanity/answer/Example-Author",
        "text": "AI poses risks, but robust governance and alignment research can mitigate them...",
        "posted_at": "2024-04-01T09:10:00.000Z",
        "metrics": {
            "comments": 3,
            "upvotes": 56
        },
        "author": {
            "name": "Example Author",
            "url": "https://www.quora.com/profile/Example-Author",
            "credential": "AI researcher"
        }
    }
}
```

- `record_type` and `url` — The normalized result type and primary Quora URL for the item.
- `source_context` — The original query or URL, loaded/search URL, scrape timestamp, requested type, and time filter.
- `status` — Whether the actor found normal results, plus a note or error for no-result records.
- `question`, `answer`, `post`, `profile`, `space`, and `topic` — Present only when that detail is available, with related metrics, media, flags, authors, and source IDs grouped inside the relevant object.

## Notes & Limitations

- Use this actor responsibly and only for lawful purposes. Review and respect Quora’s terms of service and policies before scraping or using the data.
- Public data may include personal information; ensure you have a legal basis to process and store it in your jurisdiction.
- Start with smaller result limits when testing new queries or URLs.

## Support

Questions or custom needs? Open an issue on the **Issues** tab of the actor page in Apify Console and it will be resolved around the clock.

Happy Scraping,

- Fatih
